headlines.title: Growth in China’s factory-gate prices accelerates, but consumer inflation subdued
headlines.summary:
Growth in Chinese factory-gate prices continued to accelerate last month, while consumer price growth remained subdued despite Beijing’s efforts to shore up domestic demand and support the economy in meeting its annual growth target.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5 per cent year on year in September, the highest rate since mid-2022, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday. It rose by 3.8 per cent in August.

headlines.summary_zh:
中国出厂价格上月继续加速上涨，而尽管北京方面努力提振国内需求并支持经济实现年度增长目标，消费者价格涨幅仍保持低迷。
数据显示，9月份生产者价格指数（PPI）同比上涨5%，为2022年年中以来的最高水平。

headlines.title: 中金所：正扎实推进人民币外汇期货试点准备工作
headlines.summary: 中金所党委书记、董事长何庆文在“2026上海衍生品市场论坛”上表示，中金所稳步推进扩大对外开放，为境外投资者提供多样化的风险管理工具，持续提升中国资产的吸引力。今年4月，合格境外投资者（QFI）参与国债期货交易正式落地，目前共有39家QFI备案将国债期货纳入投资品种范围，11家QFI已经获批国债期货套保额度，促进更多国际配置性资金进入我国的债券市场。目前，中金所根据中国证监会统一部署，正扎实推进人民币外汇期货试点准备工作，确保试点平稳推出。

headlines.title_en: CFFEX: Steadily advancing preparations for the RMB foreign exchange futures pilot
headlines.summary_en: He Qingwen, Party Committee Secretary and Chairman of the China Financial Futures Exchange (CFFEX), said at the 2026 Shanghai Derivatives Market Forum that CFFEX is steadily advancing the expansion of opening-up, providing overseas investors with diversified risk management tools, and continuously enhancing the appeal of Chinese assets. In April this year, Qualified Foreign Investors (QFI) participation in treasury bond futures trading was officially implemented. Currently, a total of 39 QFIs have filed to include treasury bond futures in their investment scope, and 11 QFIs have been approved for treasury bond futures hedging quotas, promoting more international allocation funds to enter China's bond market. At present, under the unified arrangements of the CSRC, CFFEX is solidly advancing preparations for the pilot program of RMB foreign exchange futures to ensure its smooth launch.

headlines.summary_en: The dual-innovation indices both fell more than 3%, and more than 5,000 stocks declined across the A-share market. The Hang Seng Index fell 1.5% in the morning session, the Hang Seng Tech Index fell nearly 3%, and Lenovo Group plunged nearly 14%. Renewed inflation stoked rate hike expectations, Asian stocks tumbled, South Korea's stock market fell 8% triggering a circuit breaker, and the Nikkei 225 fell more than 5%. Safe-haven demand drove a rebound in global bond markets, with the US 5-year Treasury yield falling 10 basis points, while Japanese government bond yields also retreated. Iron ore prices fell below $90 per ton for the first time since 2024. Zelensky said Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian oil refineries. Report: The US is considering using the "Mother of All Bombs" on Iran.

headlines.title_en: Will the Fed deliver a 50-basis-point rate hike in December? Veteran forecaster: October expected to hold steady
headlines.summary_en: [Will the Fed raise rates by 50 basis points in December? Veteran forecaster: October likely to hold steady] After the US released CPI data that comprehensively exceeded expectations, the probability of a Fed rate hike in October rose somewhat, but the probability of no hike still prevailed. However, a forecaster who had earlier predicted the Fed's September rate hike raised another possibility: in December, the central bank may raise rates by a larger margin, namely 50 basis points.

headlines.title_en: October 15 midday review: Both STAR Market and ChiNext indices fall over 3%, more than 5,000 stocks decline across the market
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market opened lower and corrected in the morning, with both dual-innovation indices falling more than 3%. Baijiu stocks bucked the trend, with Huangtai Liquor rising for the second time in three days. PCB concept stocks remained active, with Aohong Electronics hitting the limit up to a new high, while Jinhua Electronics, Tianjin Printronics, and Shennan Circuits also sealed the limit up. Innovative drug concept stocks strengthened during the session, with Baihua Pharmaceutical and North China Pharmaceutical hitting the limit up. On the downside, the shipping sector corrected, with COSCO Shipping Energy and China Merchants Energy Shipping hitting the limit down; the coal sector slumped, with Haohua Energy and Yankuang Energy falling more than 8%. Stocks generally declined, with more than 5,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets in the red, and half-day turnover of RMB 989.7 billion. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.98%, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.78%, and ChiNext fell 3.42%. 2. headlines.title: 深交所陈蔚恒：创业板今年过会企业从受理到过会平均用时189天
headlines.summary: 在今日举行的2026湾芯展第三届湾区半导体投融资战略发展论坛上，深圳证券交易所副总监、南方基地负责人陈蔚恒表示，截至2026年9月30日，深市主板新增受理11家，创业板69家，沪市主板11家，科创板52家，北交所105家，总计248家。其中，2026年4月10日改革落地以来创业板新增受理66家。截至目前，深市首发在审项目97家，其中主板17家、创业板80家。今年以来，创业板过会企业从受理到过会平均用时189天，中位数172天。思仪科技、托伦斯、超纯应材等多家企业4个月内审结。

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen Stock Exchange's Chen Weiheng: ChiNext companies approved this year averaged 189 days from acceptance to approval
headlines.summary_en: At the 3rd Greater Bay Area Semiconductor Investment and Financing Strategic Development Forum held today during the 2026 Bay Chip Expo, Chen Weiheng, Deputy Director of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and head of its Southern Base, said that as of September 30, 2026, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Main Board had 11 new acceptances, ChiNext 69, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Main Board 11, the STAR Market 52, and the Beijing Stock Exchange 105, totaling 248. Among them, since the reform took effect on April 10, 2026, ChiNext has had 66 new acceptances. So far, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has 97 IPO projects under review, including 17 on the Main Board and 80 on ChiNext. Since the start of this year, companies approved at ChiNext meetings took an average of 189 days from acceptance to meeting approval, with a median of 172 days. Several companies including Siyi Technology, Torrens, and Chaochun Yingcai completed review within 4 months.
